name: Sandbox Cruiser

reverseSpeed.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): capital ships have no reverse in the slice

rotationTime.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): cruiser 40-130 s

forwardAccel.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): cruiser accel/decel 8-18 / 4-7 s

forwardDecel.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): cruiser accel/decel 8-18 / 4-7 s

afterburner.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): capital ships have no afterburner

mass.source: Estimate (FS2 takes mass from the 3D model); only scales how hard knocks shove the ship
